gutter-bottom.$description: Space under the last control on a phone: 16px plus the home indicator's safe area

gutter-x.$description: Side padding on a phone, wider in landscape where a notch takes a side

label-tracking.$description: Uppercase section labels on the phone board ("YOUR TEAM", frame m6)

top.$description: Top padding of the phone HUD, under a status bar or notch

reserve.$description: Room left under the board for the dock (a 48px bar, its padding and the safe area), so the last row is never hidden

max-height.$description: A bottom sheet stops 40px short of the top, so the board still shows behind it

enter.$description: Sheets rise in like the drawers (D24)

width.$description: A KPI tile in the phone's sideways scroller: two and a half tiles show at 390, so the cut off tile says there is more

mask.$description: The sideways scroller fades out at its right edge, a cue that it scrolls
